169)༄༅/bka' brgyad bde gsang 'brel ba'i sgo nas nyams pa skong ba'i cho ga lag tu len tshul gaṅga'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /170)na mo gu ru/sa

tei:div.tei:p: 169) ༄༅/ bka' brgyad bde gsang 'brel ba'i sgo nas nyams pa skong ba'i cho ga lag tu len tshul gaṅga'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 170) na mo gu ru/

spros bral dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ / ye shes klong dgu'i tshem bu ru/ / shar ba bdun brgya nyi shu'i lhar// srog gi go ru mtshon byas te// dbang bzhi brgya stong bgrang bzhin du// rdo rje'i tha tshig dmyal me dang*// brje ba'i snying stobs mi dman pa'i// sngags pas sa steng gang pa'i dus// nyams len kun gyi snying po ru/ 'di nyid kho nar mthong nas ni// nye yang longs su spyod min pa'i// dag byed tshad ma 'dir mtshon bya/ de la 'dir thob par dka' ba'i dal rten/ rnyed par dka' ba'i bstan pa rin chen/ mtshan tsal thos par dka' ba'i rdo rje'i theg pa bcas la ci dgar longs spyod du yod pa'i skal bzang phun tshogs kyang*/ dug lnga hrag cing bag chags gcos ches pa'i dbang gis sdom pa dang dam tshig ji mi snyam par gyur ba'i skabs 'di lta bur/ spyir 171) bshags pa gnad du thebs pa dang khyad par thabs mkhas skong pa'i cho ga tshad ldan ma gtogs gzhan gang gis kyang lam sne zin pa lta zhog 'phral rkyen phra mo tsam sel ba'ang 'byung dka' ba lung rigs mtha' yas pas grub cing*/ de'ang don dam par lha dang dkyil 'khor rab 'byams thams cad ye shes kyi dbyings gcig gi ngang las ma g.yos shing tha dad pa med pas de'i don rtogs shing de kho na la nan bstan byed pa bshags pa kun gyi rgyal po bla na med pa ste/ rgyud las/ gang zhig bshags pa byed 'dod na// drang por 'dug la yang dag ltos// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ 'di ni 'gyod tshangs mchog yin no/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin du dam pa rigs brgya dang gsang chen rigs gcig gi bskyed bzlas skong bshags tsam las sgrub sde brgyad sogs kyi spros pa mang po dgos pa min kyang*/ kun rdzob sems can rang rang gi las snang bag chags ltar theg pa'i rnam grangs/ rgyud sde'i babs/ lha sngags kyi rnam 'gyur sogs dang*/ khyad par 172) dbang gi 'jug sgo dam tshig gi rnam grangs mtha' yas par snang ba de dag sna re ma mchis par bla ma kun nas chos thams cad shes grangs dang thob grangs 'gran ste gsan yig po ti longs pa so sor dor dang nyams len sogs dgos na rdzogs ldan gyi tshe tshad kyis kyang 'khyol dka' zhing bla ma mched grogs kyang nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam du gyur pa des na gsar rnying bka' gter gyi dkyil 'khor ji snyed gcig tu dril nas nyams su len tshul dang*/

de bzhin du lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams ma lus mi lus lus pa med par skong bshags kyi cho ga 'di lta bu'i sgo nas chu brgya zam gcig gi 'og tu bsdu ba'i thabs mkhas bla na med pa ni dpal o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin kho na las byung ba yin te/ gter kha gong 'og gsum gyi chos sde lo legs kyi snye ma lta bu 'di dag la ci dgar longs spyod du yod pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor dang lha sngags dbang skur dam tshig sogs so sor dgos phyin chad/ nyams len dang skong bshags sogs kyang so sor dgos pa rigs pas grub ste/ gzhan dun rgya gar mi gcig lha gcig gi dbang thob nas rang nyid mang por mi 'jug pa'i de kho nar gdengs bca' rung na'ang*/ gzhan don 'chad spel dang las rab 'byams kyi dngos grub gang 'dod sgrub mi chog par thal ste lha sngags gcig gis mang po'i go chod par ma gsungs ba'i phyir/ de yan zhi khro bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs 173) kyi bshags skong gi cho ga bgyi ba la thog mar sta gon bca' shom/ bar du skong ba'i 'don 'grigs/ tha mar gshin don kha sgyur gsum las rgyas par tshogs sgrub pa dang dbang skur gyi tshe/ chen po bdud rtsi sman dang dam rdzas bam sogs kyi las dang 'brel ba ni gzhan du shes la/ skong chog dkyus ma tsam gyis lag len bsdus pa ni/ thog mar gnas khang byi dor dang rgyan bkod byas pa'i gud du bsten gsum dgram/ stegs 'dom gang gru bzhi mnyam par dkyil 'khor pha brang sgo rdzogs kyi 'ding dkyil tshad ldan bkram pa'i steng du rkang gsum khar bum pa so lnga'i rdzas ldan mgul chings sna tshogs can ku sha rma bya'i kha brgyan gzungs rdor bcas 'god/ de'i mdun du che mchog gi thod sku dang lha tsaka rgyas bsdus gang 'byor/ g.yas su con pan/ rgyab tu rdo rje/ g.yon du dril bu/ mdun du rdor dril/ g.yas su gsang thod/ rgyab tu rig tsaka/ g.yon du shel rdo bcas bdag 'jug gi yo byad dang*/

de'i mdun khri'i khar dpal gtor gtso 'khor dgu rgyan spros bcas sku tsaka dang dar gdugs kyis brgyan pa'i g.yas g.yon du sman raka g.yas su tshe 'brang dang tshe ril tshe chang mda' dar/ rgyab tu rtsa gsum gyi skong gtor/ g.yon du phur pa dang sgrol gri sogs/ shar lhor gtor snod ri gling bkod pa can nang dpal 174) bshos la bya can sogs srog chags kyi mdangs gzugs srid tshad spar du btab pa bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs mchod pa'i dngos po ci 'byor/ 'di la brten nas mdos skong 'don par spro na nam mkha' chung ngu chos 'byung zur dgu can dang g.yas g.yon du mda' 'phang pho gdong mo gdong rgyang bu sogs kyis spras pa/ lho nub tu bdud rtsi dang mngar gsum sbags pa'i bam gzugs lag tu sman raka dang spyi bor dmar gtor mkha' lding mthar g.yag lug ra dang mar mes bskor ba/ nub byang du dregs gtor chos 'byung bsnol ba'i steng dmar gtor snying tshan 'khor rang 'dra sum cus bskor ba/ byang shar du ri gling steng dmar gtor ram stod zur rtse dgu 'khor bka' srung mthong brgyud ltar gyi skor ba'o/ bsdu na mtheb skyu grangs tshags brgyan pa bcas/ de'i phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i gtor ma spyi ltar las zhi bar sman sna dkar gsum/ rgyas par rin chen 'bru dar/ dbang la chang dang lan tshwa sogs/ drag por sha sna bcas rang mthun gyis spras/ byang shar du las bum rgyan ldan/ de rgyab thod chung brgya rtsa ngos rer nyi shu rtsa bdun re bkod la chang phud chos sman sbyar bas dgang*/ de rgyab dmar gtor 'phan rtse ma brgya rtsa sman gyis sbags pa/ de rgyab drag thod brgya rtsa khrag sna gtsang ma chur sbyar ba la rak+ta so lnga btab pa/ de 175) rgyab phyag bzhes ltar tshogs brgya rtsa zas snas brgyan pa/ de rgyab zhal zas dang mar me brgya rtsa bcas bkod mdzes dang*/ 'dzoms na me tog spos yon chab rnams kyang de bzhin la steng na pho brang thog phub bam tsaka gdugs su grags pa dang*/

ma 'dzoms na 'phan gdugs sogs dar dpyangs/ de'ang steng mtha' gru ma nyams pa la sman raka sogs mchod pa kun zhal nang bstan du bzhag ste nyams chag skong ba'i phyir mchod pa rnams zhal nang du bstan pa gzhung gi dgongs pa dang chags med rin po che'i kar gling zhi khro'i zin bris sogs mthun cing*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun gzigs blo gros mtha' yas zhabs kyang skong chog gnang skabs de bzhin mdzad cing mdzes chos kyi phyir bang rim can bgyi na'ang smin gling chos grags kyi skong 'grel dang kaḥthog rnying ma'i phyag srol la'ang yod cing de ltar na mchod zhal ston stangs ci bde byas kyang 'gal ba cher med snyam/ de la stegs chung dma' bar zhing lpags sogs kyi steng tshogs kyi yo byad rgyas spros dang*/ ka to ra sogs snod chen po'i nang du phud phor bcu gcig ja chang 'bru sna sogs phud skong gi yo byad dang phyag bzhes bzhin spro na bsang shug sogs kyang 'du bya/ mdangs skong rgyas par spro 176) na zur du gzhung mthun gyi bca' gzhi rgyas spros/ rgyu skong dang mdangs skong gi char srog chags dngos 'byor lha rten du 'jog 'os pa'ang rwa rna zil rgyan dang bcas nye skor du bzhag cing khye'u dang bu mo mtshan ldan rgyan spras kyang 'du bya ba sogs mdor na 'byor pas ci lcogs kyis dam rdzas rnams grwa sa'i mig ltos dang 'phral gyi 'gro 'dug lta bu ma yin par bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog cing nyes po sor chud pa'i rten 'brel gyi ched du ci nus pa ma 'dres par bshams shing mchod pa ni/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul ba// kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyi// mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod// ces dang*/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi spyan lam du// yo byad 'byor tshogs chung ba thol lo bshams/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyud lung man ngag gi dgongs par ras su ma bor bar ci nas gal che zhing*/

gzhan yang rnga rol rkang gling thod rnga sogs nye bar bsdog nyams chag skong ba'i dpon slob mtshan nyid ldan pa dang*/ dam bca' snying nye ba'i mched lcam ji ltar 'dzom pa'am/ dpa' bo gcig sgrub lta bu byas kyang rung ste chos bka' 'di yi dbang lung legs par thob cing phyag len ma nor ba shes pas nyams chag rtog sgrib la kun nas gnong 'gyod drag po ldan dgos po ni khyad par gnad dam pa'o/ dngos gzhi cho ga'i 'gros kyang spyir dong sprug gi cho ga la bla ma rnams kyi bzhed srol gyi 'gros tha dad pa sna tshogs bzhugs shing*/ bye brag du bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi las byang dang dri med bshags pa'i rgyud thab ste bshags zhing snga 'gyur bka' 177) gter gyi skong ba gung bsgrigs rgyas spros kyi tshul kun gzigs lnga pa rin po che'i phyag bzhes rgyun 'jags yongs su grags pa ltar 'dod na de yi tshul gzhan du shes/ gter kha gong ma'i bka' brgyad 'dir nyams chag gi skong chen lnga zhes dpe rgyun dang grags snyan nyi zla ltar gsal kyang de don lag tu len pa'i tshul nyin mo'i rgyu skar gy-i dper zad pa rang phyogs la nyams chag gtan nas mi srid pa'i gdeng yin nam snyams zhing*/ nyang gter bskyed rdzogs che chung gsum gsang rdzogs rang shar bcas su mi bzhugs pa'i gsar pa zhig la ya mtshan rgyu 'di yang bla ma dag gis rang bzhed kyi 'then cha sna tshogs dar che bas gter gzhung dngos kyi phrin las chu zla ltar mngon mi mngon tsam du gyur/ de'i tshul legs par bshad na gu ru rin po che'i rdo rje'i gsung rgya che bas 'dir bri bar mi lang stabs/ zur du rgyas par spros pa dag tu gsal/ tshig bcad lhug go sa rje ba la 'gangs med par bsnyad nas gzhan nas kha bskangs ba'am/ gsar du brtsams pa sogs kyis gter gzhung la sri zhu mdzad rigs rnams ni rgyal bu zhig gis rang srid bor nas sbas mthar khang rmang 'ding ba'i dper 'gyur cing gu ru rin po che las rnam dpyod ches cher yangs ba'i mkhas pa srid dam/

der ma zad dgos nges kyi zhal 'phang dang rgyas bsdus kyi dbye bsdu cung zad kyang med de/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas rab dbyer// sangs rgyas gsungs pa'i cho ga 178) kun// sla bar 'gyur cing mi byed pa// sangs rgyas kyis ni ma gsungs na/ dka' yang 'bad nas byed pa mtshar// zhes gsungs kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos sman bla'i mdo chog tu lung drangs pa ltar 'gyur ro// des na snga 'gyur bka' gter khungs thub rnams su thog mar rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i sdig sgrib nyams chag kun tu zhi ba'i sgo nas bshags shing*/ gter gzhung rgyud ltar snang ba'i rtsa gsum dam can rnams nyams sgrib dang 'gal ba rnams zung bzhi'i sgo nas sor chud par mdzad pa'i phyag bzhes nyid byang chub dgongs 'dus dang kar gling zhi khro sogs zhi khro'i skor gter kha gsar rnying kun mthun la lnga pa chen po'i gsang rdzogs kyang de ltar don la gnas pa la/ khyad par drag po rang byung rang shar gyi skong bshags che chung dag gi dgongs pa de kho nar gyur pa'i rjes su 'brangs tai phyag bzhes su star ba la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ brgyud 'debs gter gzhung*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: chos sku skye med nas/ dngos grub stsol: ham̐'u hūm̐ hūm̐: bar skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa/ maṇ+ḍal rnams grub nas bde gsang gang rung ltar gtor ma cha gsum btang*/ de nas bskyed rdzogs 'bring po'i las byang*/ hūm̐: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor= sogs nas bstod pa/ drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal lo: /bar/ 'og gi oṃ: dus gsum= 179) nas/ bshags: /bar/ he ru ka'i yig brgya dzab skul gong gi hūm̐: zhi ba= sogs nas/ thugs dam bskul: /zhes pa dzab skul zhes par bsgyur la/ phrin las mdzod: /bar btang nas rgyas bsdus 'tsho zhing spro na snyen sgrub chen mo'i ltar bya/ snyen dmigs las byang bde chen rab gsal nas byung ba ltar go sla shing*/ 'char bde/ de bzhin zhi ba dang*/

dpal dgu bka' srung dril snyen bcas grub nas kha skong du dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying*/ stong tshig hūm̐: bla ma= sogs/ ho: bar/ dge bsngo bya/ bum lha stag bla pad+ma rin chen gyi khol du byung btang ba 'jug bde/ 'dir mdun bskyed kyi tshig zin dngos su yod med kyi rgyu mtshan spyir rnying ma yongs la grags shing*/ rkyen 'jug pa'i tshul gyis snod bcud ye rdzogs chen po'i bskyed rim la mdun bskyed tshig tsam la ltos mi dgos pa'i bzhed pa dang*/ las dang po pa'i blo ngor 'char bde phyir bdag mdun so sor skyed pa'ang mdzad mod rang nyid kyi bla dang gang 'tshams des chog cing don du snod bcud dag mnyam chen po'i ngang nas gsal snang rgyun chags zhig med phyin/ mngon rtogs ji ltar bskyal yang gnad du khel dka' la/ de ltar shes na ma bskyal yang go ched la/ las dang po pa rjes mthun gyi skabs kyang tshig rjes don dran ma yengs pa zhig byung na gsang sngags/ 180) mos pas kyang 'grub par gsungs phyir 'dir zur du 'don mi dgos par byas la/ lha sngags kyi rnal 'byor grub pa'i de ma thag lta ba'i don dran par byas te/ nyams chag bshags skong la rnal 'byor pa'i gral 'dir= nas/ skong ba'o/ zhes pa'i bar brjod la de'i don la cung zad bzhag de nas 'og gi yig chung*/ rdo rje slob dpon dang= sogs nas/ mngon sum du dmigs/ bar/ na mo mañju shṝ= sogs nas/ phyag 'tshal ba'i gzungs tshar gsum/ ho: klong chen po= sogs/ dngos grub thob: zhi ba dang*/ ho: dgongs su= nas/ yig chung bskul ste che mchog gi dpal dgu rdzogs pa'i/ a la la ho: bar dang*/ gang gi= sogs phan yon bcas brjod/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'= nas 'dug ste/ ho: ston pa= nas/ nyon gcig bar brjod cing don dmigs pa ma yengs par yig brgya brgya rtsa brjod mthar / oṃ: kun tu bzang po'i= sogs nas/ ldan par gyur cig bar/ bshags rgyud las ru tra'i smre bshags dang lta ba'i klong bshags gnyis nges par 'don/

spro na theg pa lam zhugs dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs rig 'dzin yab yum gang mos/ bde gshegs spyi bshags rnams kyang gtong bar bya'o/ skabs 'dir sman raka gtor gsum dang mar me'i skong ba byang gter rang shar las byung ba'i skong ba 181) sogs tshang bar dang*/ snyen sgrub las byung ba'i mar me'i smon lam/ hūm̐: dur khrod= sogs rjod/ 'dir sman sogs so so'i dbur mi pham rin po che'i byin rlabs dang che ba skyed pa so sor sbyar na legs shing min kyang rung/ de nas tshogs/ ho: dgongs su= nas/ bka' drin che lags/ zhes pa'i bar zhu lan bya/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐:

nas/ khā hi: bar/ gnam chos sngon skong*/ tshogs 'gugs spyi 'gros/ phur thun dang*/ don bdun brgyad ma'i sngags tsam gyis sgrol zhing / bde gshegs sgrub pa= sogs/ thugs dam bskang*/ bar skang rdzas byin brlab/ mdangs skong chen mo/ hūm̐: dbus nas= sogs/ stsol bar tshang bar btang*/ rnal 'byor rgyun dbang gter gzhung tsam gyis bdag 'jug blangs bas sngags sdom sogs kyi bar/ he ru ka dgu'i sogs smon lam rjod/ ༈ tshar gnyis pa/ yang dag don la= gsang rdzogs las byang dang phyogs gnyis gong ma'i phyag rgyun bzhin sprad la snyen pa ma rdzogs bar dang dge bsngo bcas grub nas bsangs skyems sogs mchod cing bde 'dus mchod pa phud skong tshang bar btang*/ de nas na raka skong bshags/ bla ma rgyal ba= sogs= e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi= nas yig brgya brgya rtsa/ gzhung bshags/ snga ma'i mtshams su rtsa ltung bcu'i kha sgyur dang*/ klong bshags 182) sman raka gtor ma mar me'i skong ba smon lam bcas grub nas/ oṃ sarba= sogs/ tshogs gab sprad/ skong ba bar/ skong rdzas byin rlabs bder 'dus rgyu skong dang*/ gzhung ni tshogs phud/ bsngo skong bshags pa/ che bskyed 'gugs bsgral zhal bstab dbang len 'khyug tsam drang ba/ lhag ma bcas gtang*/ ༈ yang*/ bde gshegs= sogs/ las byang rkyang rgyug 'dzab snyen bsdus pa bcas grub nas na raka skong bshags nang ltar tshogs skong bar/ snga srung phyag drug bden stobs bcas sogs nas gling bzhi longs kyi skong ba tshar mang dang gzhan tshar gnyis yan btang na sa ltar 'don/ tshar grangs bzhi yan btang na skyed rdzogs chung ba'i skong ba dang*/ gsang rdzogs mdangs skong bam skong sogs res mos gtang*/ dpe sogs 'byor na rang shar las byang dang mdangs skong sogs kyang gtong na shin tu legs/ tshar rjes ma'i phyag 'tshal 'gor/ gsang rdzogs dregs gsol gdon/ tshogs bsgral mgor spyir skul dang*/ sgos skul che chung ci rigs sbyar ro/

nub mo/ dkar gtor/ gtor 'gugs/ hūm̐: sngon tshe= sogs/ chad brtan/ 'gugs pa/ hūm̐: dgra bgegs= sogs/ mnan par gsang rdzogs ltar mthar chags su sbyar bas rdo rje'i theg pa'i lam gyi gzhung zan te snyen sgrub sogs thabs gzhan la ma 183) 'bad kyang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la longs spyod par 'gyur zhing*/ tshe 'dir yang bar chad sel ba'i thabs rmad du byung ba te sngon kha bton dri med bshags rgyud dang*/ zla re bzhin du dong sprug gi cho ga mdzad pas lo tsa ba btson 'grus sku tshe bsrings ba bka' thang nas gsungs pa ltar nges pa yang dag pa'o/ gsum pa gtor ma kha skong 'og gi tshig 'das la phan gdags pa'i cho ga chun gcig tu bsgril te lag tu len pa la skyabs sems grub nas cha gsum gtor ma bar pa dang tha ma gtang*/ hūm̐: bde gshegs= sogs nas mtshams bcad mjug hūm̐ mthar cha gsum dang po'i byin rlabs dang*/ sngags bsngo grub nas/ gshin las/ sngon ston pa= sogs/ gsol lo: bar cha gsum/ shar phyogs rdo rje= sogs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lhor rigs drug gi dar dang mtshan/ mdor na so thar skabs gzhi gsum gyi cho ga sogs dang mtshungs par sngags kyi gso sbyong med du mi rung pa'i rgyu mtshan dang phan yon rgyas par rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde chen po rnams su gsal zhing*/ byang sdom la gshin las/ e ram= snod kyi= sogs nyin rnams 'byin 'jug bcas bden brdar/ dkon mchog= nas/ mchis shig: bar lan gsum/ gang dag= nas bum pa bca' 184) zhing gzhung gsal zhi ba'i gzungs sngags zlo ba nas/ phye bar bsam: bar las byang*/ hūm̐: snang srid= nas/ dzaḥho: bar/ gshin don/ ho: de bzhin= nas/ byed par bsam/ las byang*/ oṃ: khams gsum= nas/ hūm̐ phaṭa: bar/ gshin las/ hūm̐: zhes nas= bshags pa rdzogs par dang zhi ba'i 'dzab/ hūm̐: zhi ba= nas/ mdzod: gshin las/ bh+rum̐ dza= sku gsal bar gyur pa ni snyen skong stong tshig bcas/ khro bo'i 'dzab dbyangs dbye la/

gshe+in las/ hūm̐: dbus phyogs= nas/ med par bsam/ bar/ che mchog snyen pa dpal dgu 'brel gsham/ khyung*/ spyi dril/ he ru ka'i yig brgya bcas dang kun gyi gsham bu gnas 'dren mgor byung ba'i spel tshig btang kha skong mchod bstod sogs/ bum skyed/ phyag bshags nas/ mdangs skong mtha' bar gzhung ltar/ drang ba'i skabs gshin las/ ho: rdo rje slob dpon= gyur cig: bar mtshan byang la tshogs gzhag lhag ma btang grub nas/ gshin las/ e ram̐ snod kyi= nas/ shes pa bstim: bar/ gnas 'dren/ hūm̐: dkon mchog mthu dang = nas/ nri dza dza: bar/ dkon mchog gsum= mchis shig: bar lan gsum/ sbyang ba/ ram̐ kham̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis bsang sbyang byin 185) ba rlab/ oṃ sarba bhu ta a kar+sha ya dza: bar bkug zhi sbyong/ na ma= sogs lan gsum phyed ma/ sum+bha= sogs/ drag po las byang dbang bskur/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs= phrin las mdzod: bar/ gnas 'dren/ hūm̐: nga ni/ nas/ brlag: bar/ na mo/ rje btsun= sogs bden brdar/ gshin las/ gang dag= sogs/ gyur cig: bar/ sum+bha ni sogs lan gsum/ phur thun/ hūm̐: chos kyi= nas/ rlogs: drag sngags so lnga bcas/ slar gshin las/ nri dza/ nas/ sha ya a: bar/ skabs 'dir khrus rgyas par spro na gzhan nas blang*/ ma spros kyang gzhung nas ma gsungs/ gshin las/ shar=lho/ nas/ tra tha: bar/ 'og tu rdo 'gegs/ dz+wa la raṃ: nas tshul du bkod bar dmyal ba'i dal la bzhag nas 'dren no/ hūm̐: nga ni bde gshegs= sdug bsngal sbyong: gshin las/ da ha da ha= nas sreg sbyong*/ na mo rat+na= nas/ ku ru ye swa hā: bar gshin las/ de nas/ rkang mthil= nas/ pre la thim/ bar gnas 'dren/ ne wid+ya= sogs nas/ hūm̐ phaṭa: bar des dmyal bar song*/ hūm̐ phaṭa= nas/ sbyong bar/ gshin las/ pa tsa= sogs/ phaṭa: bar/ gnas 'dren / kaṃ ka= nas/ swa hā: bar/ gshin las 186)deng nas= sogs 'grel nas kha sgyur zur gsal bzhin/ dud 'gro nas lha ma grub par 'don tshar nas gshin las/ sems can chen po khyod= nas/ gyur cig:

bar/ gzhung gi dgongs par 'di yan chad rigs drug so sor nyin re bzhin nan tan byas nas bdun tshigs steng las sbyor la 'jug pa yin kyang da lta'i phyag bzhes la stabs gcig tu skyor ba khyab che bas gang la mos pa ltar gyis/ 'dir sgo lnga'i bgegs bsgral ba'i kha ṭam̐ sogs 'du bya zhing mtshan dal gru gsum du bzhag la gshin las/ kun tu bzang po'i= sogs nas/ nus pa dang ldan par gyur: bar/ gnas 'dren/ hūm̐: nyon cig= nas/ badz+ra pra we sha= sgo phyes/ gshin las/ 'o da ci nas= sogs bum pa'i dbang bskur ro: gnas 'dren/ hūm̐ḥbum par shog= nas gshin las/ badz+ra ka la= nas/ ā: bar gnas 'dren/ oṃ ā= sogs gshin las/ 'di zhes bya= sogs/ yig brgya'i mthar gnas 'dren/ hūm̐ che:mchog= sogs kyis bskul te sngags gsham bcas khrus bya/ gshin las/ hūm̐:skye med= sogs/ med par spyod: bar/ zas sna tshogs la bzhag cing*/ a ka ro sa byin brlab/ gsang rdzogs kyi zas gtad gang lcogs dang*/ gshin las 187) dgyes mchog= nas/ 'di la rol/ klong bshags/ oṃ/ chos kyi= sogs/ gnas 'dren/ hūm̐:nyon cig= nas yig chung dang*/ thim ho/ bar 'og gi hūm̐:dus gsum= nas/ swa hā/ bar/ gong du/ ho:lha dang= nas/ shog: bar/ gshin las/ rig 'dzin= sogs/ 'gyed par shog: bar dang gzhan yang smon lam ci rigs par gdab po/ 'di yi rigs drug sbyong ba'i gnas yig dpe mi dag pas/ sreg sbyong ro yi las dang bsdur nas 'akod pa'o/ ༈ 'dir zhar byung du ro sreg byed na/ spyir rgyas bas gshin po'i sgrib sbyang gi gtso 'khor phung po sreg sbyong nyid ngan song sbyong ba'i rtogs pa sogs las khyad par du bstan cing 'phags bod kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dag gis bkral ba'i gzhung shin tu mang ba las 'dir gu ru rin po ches bka' brgyad rnam pa gsum gyi gzhung las lan gcig ma yin par bstan cing bsngags par mdzad pa las bde 'dus kyi dgongs pa ltar bkral ba las/

bde gsang gang rung gi gzhung bum sgrub dang bcas pa grub nas ro yi sar phyin te/ bdag dpal chen por sogs bden 'gugs lan gsum nas 'byin 'jug ma nor bas/ khugs par bsam bar dang*/ 'jig rten 'di nas sogs yon bdag dang zhu+u lan bya zhing*/ chen po sbyin: 188) bar/ 'dir ro la dbang che chung ji rigs bskur/ spyi bor oṃ sogs dri 'don sbrags/ rlob par mdzod: de nas zhag grangs ji tsam 'os pa'i tshe skong chog gzhung bzhin las/ skabs skabs dur khrod byin 'bebs gtang*/ snyen pa sgrub skabs ro la gzungs phyag gdags la/ hūm̐ badz+ra sa twa= sogs dmigs bzlas mthar/ 'od zer= 'o/ bar dngos gzhi ro sreg khang du gzhug bdud rtsi lnga phrad dam skyobs su gyur pa'i sman dang chos sman sbags pa gzhan til dang ku sha sogs spyi 'gro'i rdzas dang mar khu/ yam shing sogs 'du bya/ las byang tshogs drang ba yan grub nas dbyangs rol bcas dur khrod byin chen las byang*/ hūm̐:bde gshegs= sogs mchod pa byin rlabs/ swa hā: bar sreg rdzas kyi spyi ltar brlab/ oṃ ba su la= sogs/ dam tshig me lha gsal ba las= 'og gi bstod pa'i nang*/ me lha ak+ne nas/ 'od zer 'bar: gong gi hūm̐:tshur gshegs= sogs/ gong gi oṃ shag raṃ sogs kyis dgang blug lan gsum dang yam shing kha nas 'bul/ oṃ ye shes sogs/ swa hā: bar dang*/ oṃ.ak+ne de bā rat+na gu ya pañca a mṛ ta tshe las 'das pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swa hā: brgya stong dang*/ bram ze drang = nas/ dpang por bzhugs 189) su gsol: rab zhi ba/ rang bzhin grub pa'i= oṃ bo d+dhi= sogs kyis dgang blug dang yam shing 'bul/ oṃ ye shes sogs/ bdag cag zhi ba'i lha la= zhes kha sgyur/ swa hā: bar/ oṃ bo d+dhi sogs/ rat+na gu ya= sogs spel ba brgya stong*/ hūm̐:chos sku= sogs/ phyag 'tshal bstod/ gang gi bde gshegs zhi ba'ilha la mthol lo bshags= sogs/ mdzad du gsol:

bar/ 'og gi bde gshegs sogs/ tsa tsa: bar/ rang bzhin= nas/ dpal dgu'i mtshan dang sngags kha bsgyur la drag sngags mthar/ tsa tsa: bar/ de nas las bzhi'i bro dus kyi snyen sgrub la/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi= sogs sam las byang gi hūm̐:dgra bgegs sogs gang rung dang smon lam/ rang byung mi dmigs= sogs/ gsal par gyur cig: bar bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad rgya cher brjod par bya'o/ de ltar grub pa'i ril bu de la dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i 'od zer gyis sgrib pa sbyong bar smon la/ yig brgya 'bum phrag gcig bzlas shing legs par bkug la sats+tsha gdab pa sogs bde 'dus zhi ba'i chos sde sku gdung tshad ldan gy-i las ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o// ma bslad rdo rje na dā'i sgra// ma dkrugs zab gteng gzhung gi 190) gnad// ma nyams byin rlabs gzi 'bar ba// ma 'bad bla ma lha yi drin// rab 'byams zhi dang khro bo'i sprin// thugs rje'i char rgyun cher g.yo ba// sgrib gsum dri ma sbyangs nas kyang*/ srid pa gting nas cis mi sprug /'dis kyang rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung*// srid pa'i mthar yang rgyu ba las// yid sprul go skabs theg pa'i gtam// tshangs chen zhing du gleng gyur cig /ces rang nyid kyang mos pa'i khar skyabs mgon lnga pa chen po'i bka' las blo gros kyi snang ba thob cing dpal yul byang 'dren bla ma dbyig gnyen bzang po nas nan tan du bskul ba la brten nas bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs kyis spel ba don dang ldan par gyur cig dge'o//
